item.title: School Choices & Education Pathways in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
School Choices & Education Pathways in Anne Arundel County

Understanding Anne Arundel County Public Schools (AACPS)

District Overview

Anne Arundel County Public Schools serves approximately 55,000+ students across 80+ schools. As one of Maryland’s largest and highest-performing districts, AACPS offers diverse educational options for students from kindergarten through 12th grade.

Key District Facts:

  • Superintendent: Dr. Mark T. Bedell (began term July 1, 2022)
  • Total Students: ~55,000+
  • Total Schools: 80+ (19 high schools, 13 middle schools, 40+ elementary schools, specialty schools)
  • Teacher-Student Ratio: Approximately 1:16
  • Website: www.aacps.org
  • Phone: 410-222-4500
  • Address: 1 County Grounds, Annapolis, MD 21401

item.title: Living in Parole, Maryland: Your Guide to Annapolis-Adjacent Suburban Life
item.description:
Welcome to Parole, Maryland

Estimated reading time: 5 minutes

Your First Look at Parole

Parole is what happens when suburban development meets proximity to a historic capital city. Located right at the western edge of Annapolis, this Anne Arundel County community blends residential neighborhoods with major shopping centers, healthcare facilities, and easy access to both the city and the broader metropolitan region.

The population sits around 15,000-16,000 residents (based on 2010 census data at 15,922, with growth since then). While it doesn’t have a traditional town center, Parole functions as a well-developed community with everything you need within a short drive.

item.title: Anne Arundel County Parking Guide
item.description:
Anne Arundel County Parking Guide

Parking in Anne Arundel County varies significantly depending on where you are. Downtown Annapolis has strict rules and paid parking. Suburban areas like Crofton and Odenton mostly offer free parking at businesses and homes.

Annapolis Parking

Downtown Annapolis

Downtown Annapolis has the most restrictive parking in the county. This is historic district with limited space and high demand.

Metered Street Parking:

  • Cost: $1.50-2.00 per hour
  • Time limits: 2-4 hours typically
  • Payment: Coin meters and mobile app (ParkMobile)
  • Hours: Monday-Saturday 9 AM - 6 PM
  • Enforcement: 7 AM - 7 PM weekdays, 9 AM - 5 PM weekends
